title: Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1 now available as a Databricks-hosted model
body:
Unity AI Gateway now supports Anthropic [Claude Fable 5.1](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#claude-fable-5-1) as a Databricks-hosted model. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
